nodes.label: Fallback Conditions
nodes.rationale: Fallback applies when Poison OSC2 is audible, serial routing or OSC interaction is active, or the profile disables the reconstruction.

nodes.label: Symmetric-Unison Fallback
nodes.rationale: Other Super Saw patches use seven-voice symmetric Vital unison with a 20-cent detune range, detune power 0.95, fitted Blend, and random oscillator phase.

nodes.label: Symmetric-Unison Fallback
nodes.rationale: Patches that use Poison OSC2 or oscillator interactions retain the symmetric-unison fallback.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Super Saw Topology
nodes.rationale: The converter reserves Vital OSC1 for the observed zero-cent cluster and repurposes muted Poison OSC2 as a five-voice auxiliary group through filter 1.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Topology Eligibility
nodes.rationale: The reconstruction applies to an isolated OSC1 Super Saw in parallel routing with BLNC=-1, no OSC interactions, and the default supersaw_asymmetric_topology profile setting.

nodes.label: Five-Voice Auxiliary Group
nodes.rationale: At full DETUNE, the group is centered at +33.6 cents with symmetric +/-69.2 and +/-144.5-cent pairs.

nodes.label: Fitted MIX Gains
nodes.rationale: Center and per-side fitted MIX gains set the two oscillator levels; the auxiliary unison uses a fixed blend that equalizes its five voices.

nodes.label: LFO2 and MPI2 Destination Omission
nodes.rationale: The reconstruction omits these destinations because they targeted the muted Poison OSC2 branch and must not animate the new auxiliary voices.

nodes.label: Measured Pitch Cluster Placement
nodes.rationale: OSC1 and the auxiliary group yield approximately -110.9, -35.6, 0, +33.6, +102.8, and +178.1 cents, within about 1.5 cents of the six resolved Poison clusters.

nodes.label: Nonlinear DETUNE Curve
nodes.rationale: Center shift and pair spacing scale with the existing nonlinear DETUNE curve.

nodes.label: Pitch-Placement-Only Scope
nodes.rationale: The asymmetric reconstruction corrects pitch-cluster placement only and is not evidence of Poison's internal oscillator architecture.

nodes.label: Remaining Super Saw Fidelity Limits
nodes.rationale: Controlled recordings retain an unresolved MIX-dependent harmonic difference, waveform/phase uncertainty, and level gap.

nodes.label: Vital Quadratic Unison Detune Scaling
nodes.rationale: Physical outer spread equals detune_range times unison_detune squared; the converter writes sqrt(outer_cents / detune_range), including for the auxiliary group.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Super Saw Topology
nodes.rationale: For isolated, single-oscillator Super Saw patches, the default conversion uses Vital OSC1 plus a five-voice OSC2 auxiliary group to match six measured pitch clusters without the prior extra low unison voice.

nodes.label: Remaining Super Saw Fidelity Limits
nodes.rationale: Super Saw waveform, phase, MIX-dependent harmonic balance, output level, and broader perceptual fidelity remain unverified.
